population: Future eligible positive-minimum-price itch.io game release under one publisher-authorized attribution cohort
unit: Impression/page/checkout/order/refund event, never automatically unique customer or transaction value
sample_frame: Official historical analytics announcements, current creator buying and payment policy; no seller account accessed
period: 2014 purchaser referral, 2018 impression reporting, 2019 referral graph and 2026 creator policy crosswalk; future owner-authorized fixed UTC observation windows
explicit_caveats: Historical creator analytics and purchase-referrer features are not a verified current joint data export.
The seller must verify that attribution is coherent across stages; the validator only checks report input consistency, not truthfulness of asserted tracking.
Orders from earlier checkout sessions and delayed refunds need an explicitly declared attribution lag; same date windows alone do not prove identical buyer cohorts.
The derived ratio is a rate of events, not a probability that an individual visitor purchased.
Free plays, optional donations, discount-to-zero keys, gifts and bundle claims do not count as retained positive-price orders.
No client event identifier, IP, email, purchase key, cookie or token is used.
Different product builds, currencies, source categories, offer changes or reporting windows invalidate a pooled funnel.
